summary:
A U.S. senator has committed to prioritizing DC statehood, while advocacy groups continue highlighting recent federal interventions in the District as evidence for why local control is needed. The coverage reflects ongoing concerns about federal overreach, including a federal takeover and National Guard deployment in Washington, D.C.

Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.

articles.title: VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
One Year After President Trump Deployed National Guard Troops to Washington, D.C., Statehood is More Important Than Ever
